name: Line / Area Chart
summary: Multi-series trends over time or categories — rebased performance, highlighted target, direct end labels, dashed estimates, event pins and zoom.
summary_zh: 多系列时间趋势：股价相对表现（重设基数为 100）、目标公司高亮、线端直接标注、预测期虚线、事件编号标注与缩放。
description_zh: 展示一个或多个指标随时间（日期字段自动使用时间轴）或类别（年度、期限）的变化。支持宽表（encode.y 为字段数组，每个字段一条线）与长表（y + series 字段）。rebase 可把每条线重设为首个有效值 = 100，用于股价相对表现；highlight 用 accent2 加粗目标公司，其余系列弱化；线端标签直接给出系列名与最新值并自动避让；“2026E”等预测年份自动转为虚线并加浅色“Projected”底纹；eventsData 绑定事件数据集后在线上显示编号图钉，悬停查看详情。时间序列默认开启缩放，纵轴随可见窗口自动重算。
best_for: Relative share price performance vs. peers and indices (rebased to 100)
Trading multiple history (NTM EV/EBITDA vs. peer median)
Financial projections with actual vs. estimate styling
Yield curves and other category-axis curves
avoid_when: More than ~8 series (use small multiples or highlight one)
Few discrete periods where magnitudes matter (use bar)
Composition of a total over time with many parts (use stacked bar)

x.desc: X field: date (time axis), category (year, tenor) or number (value axis)

y.desc: Value field, or an array of fields for wide data (one line per field)

series.desc: Long-format series field (one line per distinct value)

area.desc: false | true (light fill under each line, zero-based axis) | 'stacked'

rebase.desc: Rebase each series to its first non-null value = this number (e.g. 100); tooltip adds % change

endLabels.desc: Collision-free labels at the line ends: true (value tag + name) | 'value' | 'name' | false

highlight.desc: Series name drawn thicker in accent2 (the target); other series are muted

labels.desc: Point value labels: true | false | 'auto' (category axis, <= 12 points, <= 3 series)

labelFormat.desc: Format of point labels (defaults to format)

symbols.desc: Point markers: true | false | 'auto' (category axis with <= 24 points)

forecastFrom.desc: First estimate x value: line becomes dashed and a 'Projected' band is shaded. 'auto' detects labels like 2026E; null disables

forecastLabel.desc: Label of the estimates band (empty string hides it)

eventsData.desc: Dataset id of events (date, label, kind, detail) drawn as numbered pins

eventsEncode.desc: Field mapping of the events dataset

eventsSeries.desc: Series the pins sit on (default: highlight, else the first series)

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color}] horizontal reference lines (offer / current price), dashed in the theme's reference colour

zoom.desc: 'auto' (on for time axes with > 12 points) | true | false — slider + drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch (options.wheelZoom: true for the plain wheel); value axis re-fits to the window

xFormat.desc: X format for tooltip titles (dates default to the field format)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the y field format ('#,##0.0' when rebased)

yMin.desc: 'auto' (zero for areas, otherwise fit the data) | 'dataMin' | number

legend.desc: Legend top-left (shown when there is more than one series)

interactions: Axis tooltip with all series (and % change when rebased)
Hover near a pin to read the event
Slider, drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch zoom with automatic y re-fit (plain wheel scrolls the page)
Click a line to cross-filter (long data; generic series fields filter this dataset only)
End labels follow zoom and filters
